fact: The director of the Cadastre said at the Journees foncieres (5-7 October 2026) that the tax administration's e-Cadastre platform is contributing to the progressive dematerialisation of cadastre procedures.
The finance ministry says the Livre Foncier Electronique (LIFE) is an application letting notaries consult land titles online.
The finance ministry says notaries can consult land titles online through LIFE, with access to be extended to banks and others in the land chain.
LoGRI says the Ministry of Construction's SIGFU is digitising all existing paper maps into the ministry's database to modernise land titling.
LoGRI says prospective owners are invited to submit applications for land titles online through SIGFU.

The Direction Generale de l'Economie says the Integrated Urban Land Management System (SIGFU), created by decree in December 2021 as a computerised system for urban land data, is being put in place, with a mass parcel titling operation launched as a step of it.
system: Systeme Integre de Gestion du Foncier Urbain (SIGFU)
